text:
Priya R: Hey team — short notice: my flight got rebooked, need to swap primary for tonight 18:00-02:00 UTC. There's still the latency surge we're watching (inc-3472) so I don't want to leave a gap. Can someone take primary and I'll be secondary/backup remotely?

Alex K: I can pick up primary for that window. I'm already shadowing on the incident so continuity should be fine. Anyone cool to be sec?

Morgan L: I can be secondary for that window, have my laptop and pager on. Quick question: do we want the handoff to include a short triage summary in the incident thread or just update the oncall calendar?

Priya R: both please — update calendar and paste a 1-2 line triage at top of inc-3472 so whoever comes on knows current mitigation steps. Also add the runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/latency-incidents (shortlink)

Shaun T: tagging runbook snippet: 
```
If 95th latency > 2x baseline for 10min:
  - route traffic to fallback-region (policy: fallback-eu-us)
  - scale dedicated pool +2 GPUs
  - notify customers via status page
```
Make sure primary has perms to trigger region-fallback (IAM: oncall-primary).

Alex K: got it. I'll update the calendar entry and post the triage in the incident thread. Can someone confirm PagerDuty escalation policy is unchanged (we had a temporary tweak earlier)?

incident-bot: Incident inc-3472: latency surge detected 12:17 UTC, current impact: degraded response times for ~8% of requests. PD escalation policy: oncall-primary -> oncall-secondary -> eng-leads (policy id: pd-policy-17).

Morgan L: PD looks normal per the bot. One ask: priya, do you want me to take active alerts or just be standby? I'm happy to ACK but prefer Alex handle page firing unless I'm asked to fully take on calls.

Priya R: Alex will be active primary. Morgan standby for escalation. I'll remain reachable and can step in if region-fallback needs approval. Thanks both.

Shaun T: small ops note — please run the quick healthcheck after handoff: `curl -sS https://health.redwood/v1/serving | jq .seq_latency` and confirm 95p < 1.5x. Put the result in the incident thread.

Alex K: Will do. I'll post: "handoff: Alex primary, Morgan secondary, Priya backup (remote)" and paste last telemetry. Then I'll update the oncall calendar event summary to include the PD rotation change and runbook link. :white_check_mark:

Priya R: thanks. One last bit — patch the rotation spreadsheet if you swap permanent shifts: https://docs.redwood/schedules/oncall (this is a short swap, not permanent).

Alex K: noted. Handoff posted to inc-3472 and calendar updated. Beginning coverage at 18:00 UTC. Morgan, I'll DM you my contact and brief you live at 17:50 UTC for the quick runthrough.

Morgan L: Sounds good. I'll be available and will ACK any PD pages if they escalate to me.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Alex K, secondary=Morgan L, backup=Priya R. Coverage window 1719999999->1720003600.

Priya R: perfect — thanks all. If anything changes ping @shaun for escalation to eng-leads.
